name: gmail-ui
description: OpenGym Gmail agent environment and UI

scripts.dev: export DISABLE_AUTH=1 && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 ulimit -n 20000 || true && rm -rf generated && rm -rf public/generated && next dev --turbopack
scripts.dev-random: export DISABLE_AUTH=1 && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 ulimit -n 20000 || true && npm run generate:randomization && next dev --turbopack
